scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Finite integral homotopy classification and integral persistence of the inclusive graph-shortest-path Vietoris–Rips complex of the icosidodecahedral graph.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Fully specified exact finite Morse pairings, global Hasse acyclicity checks, signed integral boundary reduction, a geometric sphere cycle and exhaustive integral cocycle evaluations; standard discrete-Morse and CW attachment arguments.
scientific_integrity.scientific_limitations: No Euclidean-metric or equivariant classification; potential nonindexed equivalent prior work; independent validation not performed.

title: Complete graph-metric Rips persistence of the icosidodecahedral graph
